name: CIS Docker
description: Center for Internet Security Docker Benchmark

controls.name: Docker socket permissions
controls.desc: A world-accessible Docker socket allows any local user to run containers with full host access.

controls.name: Non-root container user
controls.desc: Running containers as root means a container escape gives the attacker full host privileges.

controls.name: No privileged containers
controls.desc: Privileged mode disables all container security boundaries, granting full access to host devices and kernel.
